origin_order: First 300 entries of the full 4090-origin epoch-0 CPU randperm seeded with 42; no subset reshuffling

comparison.rule: abs(a-b) <= atol + rtol*max(abs(a),abs(b)); finite values required; no division by near-zero values
comparison.justification: Strict determinism, identical seed/order/noise and configuration require exact equality; no historical variability allowance
comparison.exact_fields: All persisted non-timing non-metric fields, full final model/optimizer/scheduler/RNG trees, counters and configuration excluding run identity
comparison.selection_cadence: Every complete epoch; none expected in this short trial
comparison.stopping_epoch_comparison: Not applicable: no early stopping occurs

negative_control.fixture: copy on_b comparison inputs into a separate fixture directory
negative_control.expected: comparison fails specifically at step 150 loss

job.layout: One MPI controller; fresh Python worker per run sequentially on isolated flat tile 0, each asserts one visible device and selects device 0
job.budget_accounting: Allocation start before module setup through job end; full worker subprocess startup, training, checkpoint and comparison elapsed times separately recorded; queue excluded
job.retry_policy: No automatic retry after failed verification; budget exhaustion is incomplete/fail, never pass

preparation: Copy and hash-check the existing v4 embedding cache into the new V2 run root on compute; dataset, audit and scales read only; no dependency installation
checks: Run focused harness tests on compute before the two real training runs
limitations: 300 steps do not reach the 4090-origin epoch boundary
No validation, patience-3 stopping or production OFF acceptance is claimed
Synthetic profile timings are not acceptance evidence
